notes.title: Demo update (d0.3.1) patch notes
notes.content:
[b]General changes:[/b]
Improve Flesh Fest difficulty
 • Enemy count increased
 • Skeanners move faster and hit faster
 • Ragzoids are on steroid
 • Headnails aim faster and may shoot a burst of metal bolts
 • Nosorogs are immune, aim to the sacks

[b]Enemy changes:[/b]
Nosorogs reworked
 • Replace immunity with larger HP pool on lower difficulties, aiming to the sacks may prove better
Meatballs health points increased
Meatballs size increased (hitbox is still the same size)
Ragzoids got smarter at aiming on harder difficulties

[b]Weapon changes:[/b]
Sword damage slightly increased
Assault rifle damage slightly increased
Double barrel shotgun reworked
 • New pellet spray algorithm implemented
 • Pellet spray should prove better in close/mid/large range now
 • Pellet quantity increased
 • Pellet damage decreased
 • Effectiveness against meatballs increased
Plasma gun damage slightly increased

[b]New settings:[/b]
Add HUD scale setting

[b]Improvements:[/b]
Update E1M1 and E1M3 layout to prevent softlock spots
Update translations
Minor visual improvements
Fix non critical bugs

[b]Other:[/b]
Change wind direction

notes.title: ASKE demo has arrived!
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce that you can download the demo version of ASKE now. You will be able to experience three full maps from episode one, horrible creatures await for you, don't be late!

If you have a good time while playing please consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/nqVQkw5]Discord server[/url] to stay updated about future content and chat with other players, or share tips and secrets.

[b]Grab your favorite drink and start shooting![/b]

notes.title: Free demo release date and Realms Deep 2021 announcement
notes.content:
Hello boomers, I have some exciting news to share with you.

The demo for ASKE will be available on August 13th, you will be able to experience and have a taste of the three starting maps from episode one for FREE.

Also, a premiere of the demo trailer is going to take place on August 14th during the main Realms Deep 2021 event. Right after watching some awesome game trailers you can come back to the store page to grab your free demo copy and have a bloodbath!
